    1                                                // Count accepted writes locally and retirements after a complete stop bit in
    2                                                // the UART domain. A delayed idle level alone would falsely report idle just
    3                                                // after an APB write. Use four times FIFO depth as the modulo capacity to also
    4                                                // cover the active frame and the registered retirement pipeline at depth two.

    86                                                   // in the FIFO without asserting the interrupt.

    91
